title: Offer kanso-jetbrains upstream
description:
0.1.0 builds and passes nix flake check (palette drift; merged-theme tests: no stock colors, UI text >= 4.5:1, code >= 3:1) and Plugin Verifier against IU-263.7307.200 (Compatible). The repository is public and release v0.1.0 carries the jar.

Next: ask the kanso.nvim author whether they want the port; optionally publish to JetBrains Marketplace.

title: Tighter Islands spacing in compact density
description: Done: ui_overrides sets Island.borderWidth.compact=2 (parent 4), Island.arc.compact=10 (16), Island.borderArcLength.compact=6 (10) for every variant; default density keeps the parent values. README notes it. Verification: the merged theme (kanso_jetbrains.intellij.load) has the three values for zen, ink, mist and pearl; nix flake check passed. Reaches the IDE only after a new release and nixos-config's plugin lock update.
